data.gender_notes: Mueenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'awna', which means 'to support, protect, or save'. In Islamic tradition, Mueenah symbolizes the idea of being under the protection and care of God. The name Mueenah carries the meaning “Secure, protected, saved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mueenah usually hope their child will grow to embody secure, protected, saved and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mueenah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
